items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I worked with him later, too... Mitch Miller was the conductor... Mitch Miller was the director.

ctx.x: I worked with him later, too. Osie (inaudible) Johnson and I, we made the Other Voices album. And I played with the Cleveland Symphony. One of my big moments, at least ten bass players and almost 200 musicians, and Mitch Miller was the conductor. Nat Pierce (had phonetic) made the arrangements because Errol couldn't read; and we were going to play the "Other Voices" arrangement before Errol was going to be presented with the trio and these bass players sounded like pachyderms and the conductor wiped them all out…
